name: robotics-skills
description: Robotics advisors covering 18 domains (method fundamentals, ROS 2 architecture, arms, hands, mobile bases, legged robots, aerial, marine, soft robots, perception, safety, simulation, fleets, swarms, field, medical, robot learning, and the harness that wraps a learned policy), two tool skills for recorded-episode health and video relay judder, three team skills (a read-only audit team, an autonomous diagnose-and-fix autopilot, and a read-only preflight team that issues one go/no-go sheet before a session on a shared robot) with ten agents and three workflows, plus robotics-radar, a self-maintenance sweep. Each advisor grounds answers in fundamentals, runs a live source-verified search on every invocation, and leads with a verdict and the options it weighed.
